Favors use of CCTA.Goal: Rule out obstructive CAD; Detect nonobstructive CAD.
Favors use of CCTA.Availability and expertise: High-quality imaging and expert interpretation routinely available.
Favors use of CCTA.Other compelling indications: Anomalous coronary arteries; Require evaluation of aorta or pulmonary arteries.

Favors use of stress imaging.Availability and expertise: High-quality imaging and expert interpretation routinely available.
Favors use of stress imaging.Other compelling indications: Suspect scar (especially if PET or stress CMR available); Suspect coronary microvascular dysfunction (when PET or CMR available).

3.2.2 Echocardiography/Stress Echocardio.Purpose: Visualize and aid in the differential diagnosis among numerous causes of acute chest pain such as acute aortic dissection, pericardial effusion, stress cardiomyopathy, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
3.2.2 Echocardiography/Stress Echocardio.Additional Information: TTE provides information for CAD risk assessment and clinical decision-making in patients with acute chest pain.
